Separate coffee and tea requirements Identify whether the pack will hold coffee beans, ground coffee, loose-leaf tea or sachets. Check usable volume with that product. Review valve requirements for roasted coffee separately from tea storage, and choose the structure around the required protection and storage conditions. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals. Review the filled sample against shelf depth before fixing the dieline. Review zipper access and final sealing Confirm zipper location, usable opening and the final top-seal allowance. Check filling access, opening and reclosing with the actual contents. Include any valve as a separate specified component.
